activity.description: The internet line's speed now and the computers sending and receiving data at the moment. Refreshed every 10 seconds while the page is open.

lines.title: Internet line
lines.none: The internet line is not measured
lines.noneHint: The line's speed is read from the firewall's interface counters with read-only SNMPv3. No source has SNMP on.

status.no_such_interface: The interface is not on the device

now.title: Right now
now.more: The {{shown}} rows that download the most are shown.
now.interim: Long connections appear as FortiGate's interim logs arrive. MikroTik sends no byte counts; it does not appear here.
now.warmingUp: The figures are not complete yet
now.warmingUpHint: The count is either still reading the last 60 minutes (the worker has just started) or has not been updated for over a minute. The table and chart fill in shortly; if this persists, an administrator should check the worker on the System page.
now.locked: The usage analytics module is off
now.lockedHint: The "Right now" table belongs to the usage analytics module. The internet line's speed is shown without it.
